link_preview.title: Bass Pi - Restricted: Lockdown Mode boot: Bass OS Kiosk mode for the Raspberry Pi 4
link_preview.description_html:
Uboot menu & initial startup of Bass Pi, showcasing an out of the box experience for using the free version of Restricted Launcher from Navotpala Tech.
Restricted Launcher when booted in Admin mode allows you to use all the features of Android while unlocked.…
